breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the exact thick-walled torsion formulas (J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32 and τ = T*(do/2)/J) rather than the thin-walled tube approximation (mean-area shear-flow relation) that was incorrectly specified in the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth prompt which only specifies the standard polar moment of inertia formula without any mention of thin-walled approximation.
